topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The light today, it dances, skips through the leaves and across my skin. This morning, the air holds a promise, whispers of change with a gentle breeze. The building, our home, it's like a great, ancient tree we've nestled into, roots deep and strong. Now, they say, parts of the tree will belong to those who tend it. No longer just a place we rest, but a nest we call our own. I breathe deep, the scent of morning dew, the murmur of neighbors, the bustling of the street below blending into a symphony of belonging. The future, it sparkles with possibility, like dewdrops catching the sun.
